name: Safe Place for Youth: work and school help
what_you_do: For youth who are homeless or at risk of it. Staff help with job readiness, resumes, mock interviews, college or trade school applications, and a youth internship program. There is a paid internship in the community garden.
who_can_apply: Youth experiencing or at risk of homelessness. The age range is not stated on the program pages.
pay_detail: A paid internship through the Community Garden is mentioned. The pay rate is not stated. Cost to join is not stated.
how_to_apply: Call 310-902-2283 or email info@safeplaceforyouth.org. The site is at 2471 Lincoln Blvd, Suite 101, Los Angeles. General hours are Mon to Thu 9:15 to 7:00, Fri 9:15 to 6:15, Sat and Sun 9:30 to 3:30.
notes: Ask when you call what ages they serve, because the pages do not say. If you are in danger right now, call 911.
